notes.title: FULL RELEASE!!! - Version 1.0
notes.content:
Today, 14th December 2015, we are happy to announce that we have released the 1.0 version of Gabe Newell Simulator!!!

After several months of early access we have fixed many bugs, we improved the frame rate of the video game, added new game modes, expanded levels with new rooms and objects, added dialogues between characters, added new music, added version for Mac & Linux and much more !!

We hope you like the new version!! :)

ːgabenː

[img]http://i.imgur.com/7YCfOHx.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Steam Mode!
notes.content:
With this new update, we have added a new game mode, the STEAM mode, where you can manage steam and decide what type of game release on the platform, what to buy and what to develop! (also included the steam sales!)

Other improvements to the game are as follows:
-Added dialogues with employees
-New game areas
-New Trailer and logo
-Better frame rate
-Bug fixes

ːgabenː
